project.name: treetracker-wallet-app
project.description: Greenstand's secure, user-friendly digital wallet for managing and transferring tokens, built as a Yarn workspaces monorepo with a Next.js web app, an Expo React Native mobile app, a NestJS user API, and shared TypeScript packages. It is part of the Greenstand ecosystem for transparent and verifiable tree planting.

nodes.name: steps.ts
nodes.summary: WebdriverIO Cucumber step definitions for the BDD E2E suite: Keycloak login and registration, wallet create and details, token details and map tab, send/accept/decline/cancel transfers, settings, and wallet customization with image uploads. Seeds accounts through utils/seed.ts and finds pending transfers with the wallet getTransfers and getTransferTokens API clients.
nodes.languageNotes: Step callbacks use browser.execute to run DOM code in the page context, for example to set Keycloak inputs, inject PNG File blobs into file inputs, and click elements that overlays intercept.

nodes.name: acceptTransfer.ts
nodes.summary: Wallet package API client that lets a receiver accept a pending transfer via POST /transfers/:id/accept on the wallet API. Consumed by usePendingTransfers and re-exported from the package index.

nodes.name: cancelActionToken.ts
nodes.summary: API client that revokes an outstanding share link (action token) through DELETE /action-tokens/:id so it can no longer be redeemed. Used by the useActionTokens hook.

nodes.name: cancelTransfer.ts
nodes.summary: API client that lets a sender cancel a transfer they initiated, before the receiver accepts it, via DELETE /transfers/:id. Consumed by usePendingTransfers.

nodes.name: createWallet.ts
nodes.summary: API client that creates a new managed wallet with POST /wallets, mapping the shared Wallet type's name and about fields into the request body. Used by useCreateWallet and by the createWallet e2e test.

nodes.name: declineTransfer.ts
nodes.summary: API client that lets a receiver decline a pending transfer via POST /transfers/:id/decline. Consumed by the usePendingTransfers hook.

nodes.name: errors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the typed wallet API error that carries the server reason slug, plus a predicate for the no_wallet case, so clients can branch without parsing message text. Imported by redeemActionToken.

nodes.name: generateActionToken.ts
nodes.summary: API client with input and result types for issuing a signed, expiring action token (share link) via POST /action-tokens, which authorizes a later transfer of specific tokens or an N-token bundle out of the caller's wallet.

nodes.name: getActionTokens.ts
nodes.summary: API client for listing the caller's issued share links via GET /action-tokens with optional state, limit and offset filters, returning ActionTokenSummary records. Used by the useActionTokens hook.

nodes.name: getToken.ts
nodes.summary: API client that fetches one token record from the wallet API via GET /tokens/:id. Consumed by the useGetToken hook.

nodes.name: getTokenTransactions.ts
nodes.summary: API client that retrieves the transaction (lineage) history of a token via GET /tokens/:id/transactions. Consumed by the useGetTokenTransactions hook.

nodes.name: getTokenTree.ts
nodes.summary: API client and TokenTree type for fetching the tree linked to a token (tree id, image URL, species name) from the public Treetracker query API instead of the wallet API. Used by useGetTokenTree.

nodes.name: getTransfer.ts
nodes.summary: API client that fetches the details of one transfer via GET /transfers/:id. Used by the useGetTransfer hook.

nodes.name: getTransferTokens.ts
nodes.summary: API client that lists the tokens included in a transfer via GET /transfers/:id/tokens. Used by useGetTransfer and by the BDD send-token steps to find the received token id.

nodes.name: getTransfers.ts
nodes.summary: API client and GetTransfersParams type for listing transfers via GET /transfers with pagination, state, wallet, date-range and sort filters. Used by useGetTransfers, usePendingTransfers and the BDD steps.
nodes.languageNotes: The second parameter is a union (number | GetTransfersParams) so legacy getTransfers(token, 5) calls keep working next to the filter-object form.

nodes.name: getWallets.ts
nodes.summary: API client that lists the caller's wallets via GET /wallets with a limit parameter. Consumed by the useGetWallets hook.

nodes.name: redeemActionToken.ts
nodes.summary: API client and result type for redeeming a share link via POST /action-tokens/redeem, which moves the named tokens from the sender wallet into the caller's wallet as one completed transfer. Throws the typed WalletApiError so callers can detect reasons such as no_wallet.

nodes.name: sendTransfer.ts
nodes.summary: API client and SendTransferInput type for starting a transfer of specific token ids or of an N-token bundle from a sender wallet to a receiver wallet via POST /transfers. Used by the useSendTransfer hook.

nodes.name: keycloakLogin
nodes.summary: Fills the Keycloak hosted login form by setting #username and #password through browser.execute (to avoid WebDriver special-character handling), clicks #kc-login, and waits for the app navigation-home element. Used by the login, registered-account, settings and switchUser steps.

nodes.name: switchUser
nodes.summary: Switches the browser to another user: it visits the Keycloak realm origin to delete its SSO cookies, clears app storage and cookies on /login, then calls keycloakLogin. Used by the two-user send-token, transfers and customize-wallet scenarios.

nodes.name: acceptTransfer
nodes.summary: Sends an authenticated POST to TREETRACKER_WALLET_API/transfers/{id}/accept and returns the completed transfer; maps Axios response errors to Error with the API message or 'Failed to accept transfer'. Wrapped by usePendingTransfers as its accept action.

nodes.name: cancelActionToken
nodes.summary: Issues an authenticated DELETE to /action-tokens/{id} and returns the cancelled link summary, converting Axios errors to Error('Failed to cancel share link') or the server message. Called by useActionTokens.cancel before the list reloads.

nodes.name: cancelTransfer
nodes.summary: Sends an authenticated DELETE to /transfers/{id} and returns the cancelled transfer, surfacing the API error message or 'Failed to cancel transfer'. Wrapped by usePendingTransfers as its cancel action.

nodes.name: createWallet
nodes.summary: Posts { wallet: walletData.name, about: walletData.about } to /wallets with a Bearer token and returns the created wallet; logs and rethrows Axios errors as Error with the server message or 'Failed to create wallet'. Takes (walletData, token), unlike the other clients.

nodes.name: declineTransfer
nodes.summary: Posts an empty body to /transfers/{id}/decline with a Bearer token and returns the resulting transfer, rethrowing the server message or 'Failed to decline transfer'. Wrapped by usePendingTransfers as its decline action.

nodes.name: WalletApiError
nodes.summary: Error subclass named WalletApiError that stores an optional readonly reason slug from the wallet API response next to the message. Thrown by redeemActionToken on HTTP error responses.

nodes.name: isNoWalletError
nodes.summary: Predicate that returns true when an unknown error is a WalletApiError whose reason equals 'no_wallet', which means the signed-in account has no wallet yet.

nodes.name: generateActionToken
nodes.summary: Builds a body with the explicit token id list or a bundle { bundle_size }, plus recipient_email and sender_wallet, posts it to /action-tokens, and returns { action_token, expires_at, token_count }; errors become 'Failed to generate action token' or the API message.

nodes.name: getActionTokens
nodes.summary: Serializes optional state, limit and offset params into a URLSearchParams query, performs an authenticated GET on /action-tokens, and returns { action_tokens, query, total }; failures raise 'Failed to get share links' or the server message.

nodes.name: getToken
nodes.summary: Performs an authenticated GET on TREETRACKER_WALLET_API/tokens/{id} and returns the token object, translating Axios errors to Error('Failed to get token') or the API message. Called by useGetToken.

nodes.name: getTokenTransactions
nodes.summary: Calls GET /tokens/{id}/transactions?limit={limit} (default 100) with a Bearer token and returns the { history } payload; errors map to 'Failed to get token transactions' or the server message.

nodes.name: getTokenTree
nodes.summary: Sends an unauthenticated GET to TREETRACKER_QUERY_API/tokens/{id} and returns the TokenTree data; Axios errors become 'Failed to get the tree for this token' or the server message.

nodes.name: getTransfer
nodes.summary: Performs an authenticated GET on /transfers/{id} and returns the transfer object, rethrowing the API message or 'Failed to get transfer'. Called in parallel with getTransferTokens by useGetTransfer.

nodes.name: getTransferTokens
nodes.summary: Calls GET /transfers/{id}/tokens?limit={limit} (default 100) with a Bearer token and returns { tokens }; errors become 'Failed to get transfer tokens' or the server message.

nodes.name: getTransfers
nodes.summary: Accepts a numeric limit (back-compat) or a params object, builds the query with limit default 5, optional offset/state/wallet/before/after, and sort_by created_at, order desc defaults, then returns { transfers, query, total } from the authenticated GET.

nodes.name: getWallets
nodes.summary: Performs an authenticated GET on /wallets?limit={numberOfWallets} (default 10) and returns the raw response with the wallets array; failures raise 'Failed to get wallets' or the server message.

nodes.name: redeemActionToken
nodes.summary: Posts { action_token, wallet? } to /action-tokens/redeem with a Bearer token and returns the transfer result; on HTTP errors it throws WalletApiError with the server message and the reason slug.

nodes.name: sendTransfer
nodes.summary: Builds a tokens-list or bundle body with sender_wallet, receiver_wallet and claim (default false), posts it to /transfers, and returns the created transfer; errors become 'Failed to send transfer' or the API message.

nodes.name: updateWallet.ts
nodes.summary: API client that updates a wallet profile through PATCH /wallets/:id with multipart FormData, because the API rejects JSON, including optional cover and logo image blobs. Used by the useUpdateWallet hook.

nodes.name: useActionTokens.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that loads the share links (action tokens) of the signed-in user and exposes a cancel action that revokes a link and refreshes the list.

nodes.name: useCreateWallet.ts
nodes.summary: Thin React hook that binds the createWallet API call to the current auth token from the core tokenAtom.

nodes.name: useGetToken.ts
nodes.summary: React hook and TokenDetails type for loading a single token record by id from the wallet API.

nodes.name: useGetTokenTransactions.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that loads the transaction (lineage) history of one token for display on the token details page.

nodes.name: useGetTokenTree.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that loads the tree data linked to a token from the public query API, without authentication.

nodes.name: useGetTransfer.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that loads the details of one transfer together with the list of tokens it carries.

nodes.name: useGetTransfers.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that loads the newest transfers of the signed-in user and re-exports the Transfer type for consumers.

nodes.name: useGetWallets.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that loads the wallets of the signed-in user and normalizes each one for display, including a formatted creation date.

nodes.name: useIncomingTransfers.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that narrows pending transfers to the ones addressed to the user's own wallets, which are the only transfers the user can accept.

nodes.name: usePendingTransfers.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that lists requested and pending transfers, optionally scoped to one wallet, and exposes accept, decline and cancel actions that reload the list.
nodes.languageNotes: withReload is a higher-order function that turns each (token, id) API call into an (id) action which checks auth and reloads the list after the call.

nodes.name: useSendTransfer.ts
nodes.summary: Thin React hook that binds the sendTransfer API call to the current auth token from the core tokenAtom.

nodes.name: useUpdateWallet.ts
nodes.summary: Thin React hook that binds the multipart updateWallet API call to the current auth token from the core tokenAtom.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel entry point of the @treetracker/wallet package that re-exports every API client, React hook and shared type, including getTokens and useGetTokens. The createWallet e2e test imports it, while the BDD steps bypass it to avoid pulling in React hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses only `export *` re-exports, so the import scanner records no resolved imports for this file.

nodes.name: wallet.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript types for the wallet package: Wallet, Transfer (with both list and detail field names), ActionTokenSummary, Transaction and WalletProfileUpdate, mirroring wallet API responses. Imported by the API clients, hooks and the e2e test.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves the wallet API and query API base URLs at load time: from NEXT_PUBLIC_* env variables (loaded via dotenv) on web, or from Expo Constants extra config on React Native. Imported by every wallet API client.
nodes.languageNotes: expo-constants is loaded with a runtime require inside the native branch, so web bundles never import it.

nodes.name: createWallet.spec.e2e.ts
nodes.summary: Jest end-to-end test that gets a real Keycloak access token and calls createWallet through the package index against the live wallet API, checking a successful create and a rejected empty-name request.

nodes.name: updateWallet
nodes.summary: Appends display_name, about, add_to_web_map and optional cover_image/logo_image blobs to a FormData, sends an authenticated PATCH to /wallets/{walletId} with a 30s timeout so the save spinner cannot hang, and returns the updated wallet.

nodes.name: useActionTokens
nodes.summary: Reads the auth token from the core tokenAtom via jotai, loads links with getActionTokens on mount, and returns { links, isLoading, error, reload, cancel } where cancel calls cancelActionToken and then reloads.

nodes.name: useCreateWallet
nodes.summary: Returns { createWallet } whose function throws 'User not authenticated' when no token exists, otherwise forwards the Wallet data and the token to the createWallet API client.

nodes.name: useGetToken
nodes.summary: Fetches the token with getToken whenever the auth token or the id changes, skips the call when either is missing, and returns { token, isTokenLoading, error }.

nodes.name: useGetTokenTransactions
nodes.summary: Calls getTokenTransactions with the auth token and token id on change, stores result.history as Transaction[] with an empty fallback, and returns { transactions, isLoading, error }.

nodes.name: useGetTokenTree
nodes.summary: Fetches TokenTree data via getTokenTree whenever the id changes, skips the call for an empty id, and returns { tree, isTreeLoading, treeError }.

nodes.name: useGetTransfer
nodes.summary: Runs getTransfer and getTransferTokens in parallel with Promise.all, treats a token-list failure as an empty list, and returns { transfer, tokens, isLoading, error }.

nodes.name: useGetTransfers
nodes.summary: Loads up to limit (default 5) transfers with getTransfers through a memoized load callback and returns { transfers, isTransfersLoading, error, reload }.

nodes.name: useGetWallets
nodes.summary: Calls getWallets(token, 10), maps each wallet to id, name, about, display_name, logo/cover URLs, token counts and an en-US long-form created_at date, and returns { wallets, isWalletLoading, error, reload } where reload resolves true on success.

nodes.name: useIncomingTransfers
nodes.summary: Combines useGetWallets and usePendingTransfers, builds a memoized set of the user's wallet names, filters transfers by destination_wallet, and returns { incoming, isLoading } with a merged loading flag.

nodes.name: usePendingTransfers
nodes.summary: Fetches requested and pending transfers in parallel via getTransfers (limit 100 each), merges them, and returns accept, decline and cancel actions that a withReload wrapper builds around acceptTransfer, declineTransfer and cancelTransfer.

nodes.name: useSendTransfer
nodes.summary: Returns { sendTransfer } whose function throws 'User not authenticated' without a token, otherwise forwards the SendTransferInput to the sendTransfer API client.

nodes.name: useUpdateWallet
nodes.summary: Returns { updateWallet } whose function checks for an auth token and forwards walletId, WalletProfileUpdate fields and optional cover/logo blobs to the updateWallet API client.

nodes.name: ActivityItem.cy.tsx
nodes.summary: Cypress component test that mounts ActivityItem with sample transfers and asserts that the title, the signed amount (+100, -200) and the status render, and that showAmount={false} hides the amount of a cancelled transfer.

nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Client-side auth gate for every route in the (protected) group: it shows LoadingSpinner until mount, redirects to /login when tokenAtom is empty or another tab broadcasts logout, and wraps pages in SnackbarProvider, HeaderProvider, Header and BottomNavigationBar. It mounts PendingClaimHandler only when localStorage holds a pending claim link.
nodes.languageNotes: The "(protected)" folder is a Next.js App Router route group: the name does not appear in URLs, but this layout wraps every nested page.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Notifications screen that lists pending incoming transfers from the useIncomingTransfers hook of @treetracker/wallet, shows an empty state when there are none, and navigates to /notifications/details?id=<id> when the user taps an item.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Wallet search screen that filters a hard-coded WALLETS_DATA mock list by the header search query (name, company or address), picks send or request copy from the ?action= param, and opens WalletDetailModal for the chosen wallet. It also exports the Wallet interface for the mock records.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Account settings screen that loads the signed-in user's email and member-since date through loadUserProfile, shows partial data or an error alert, opens the Keycloak account console via accountUrl for password management, and routes to /logout.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Public /login route that triggers the Keycloak hosted login redirect once on mount, with a ref guard against React strict-mode double effects, and shows a spinner meanwhile.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Public /signup route that sends the visitor to the Keycloak hosted registration page once on mount (ref-guarded for strict mode) and renders a spinner inside a signup-redirect test box.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: OIDC redirect target /auth/callback that waits for KeycloakProvider to finish processing the authorization code, then replaces the route with /home when authenticated or /login otherwise.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Public /claim landing page for shared token links: it reads ?action_token=, saves the token for signed-out visitors and offers sign in or register, redeems it at once for signed-in users via redeemActionToken, and sends users with no wallet to /wallet with the token kept pending. It renders separate working, claimed, failed, needsAuth and needsWallet screens.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: The /logout route clears the mirrored session token and the stored Keycloak tokens, broadcasts logout to other tabs, awaits Keycloak init so the end-session redirect works on a fresh load, then calls Keycloak logout back to /login.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Root / route that reads the authoritative authenticated flag from the useAuth hook of KeycloakProvider and redirects to /home or /login, which avoids an earlier sessionStorage race that caused a login loop.

nodes.name: keycloak.ts
nodes.summary: Browser-only singleton wrapper around keycloak-js, configured from NEXT_PUBLIC_KEYCLOAK_* env vars, that provides an idempotent PKCE init which resumes sessions from tokens kept in sessionStorage (kc_tokens), plus login, register, logout and account-console URL helpers for the auth pages and KeycloakProvider.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level let variables hold a lazily created instance and a memoized init promise, which makes init safe under React strict-mode double invocation.

nodes.name: sessionChannel.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-tab logout signalling over a BroadcastChannel named wallet-auth, needed because the session token lives in per-tab sessionStorage; the logout page broadcasts and the protected layout listens.

nodes.name: ActivityItem.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable MUI card row that shows an initials avatar, a title, an optional status line and a signed amount (green when positive), with optional click handling; the search page and ActivityList render it, and a Cypress component test covers it.

nodes.name: ProtectedLayout
nodes.summary: Default layout component that tracks mount and token-check state, redirects to /login when no token is present, subscribes to cross-tab logout via onLogout to clear tokenAtom, and renders children inside the snackbar and header providers with the header and bottom bar.

nodes.name: Notifications
nodes.summary: Page component that renders a spinner while incoming transfers load, then one clickable Paper per pending transfer with source wallet, token count and destination, or an empty-state icon and message.

nodes.name: SearchContent
nodes.summary: Inner search component that reads the action query param, forces the header search open, filters and caps the mock wallet list (6 rows without a query, 10 with one), renders matches as ActivityItem rows and opens WalletDetailModal on selection.

nodes.name: Search
nodes.summary: Default export of the search route that wraps SearchContent in a Suspense boundary with LoadingSpinner as fallback, which the App Router requires for useSearchParams.

nodes.name: Account
nodes.summary: Account page component that fetches the profile for the current tokenAtom value with cancellation on unmount, formats the creation date, sets session-expired or load-failure errors, and renders email, member-since, a security link and a logout button.

nodes.name: LoginPage
nodes.summary: Component that calls the keycloak login() redirect inside a one-shot effect and renders LoadingSpinner in a login-redirect box.

nodes.name: SignUpPage
nodes.summary: Component whose one-shot effect calls keycloak register() to open the hosted registration form, rendering a spinner until the browser leaves.

nodes.name: AuthCallbackPage
nodes.summary: Component that reads ready and authenticated from useAuth and, once ready, calls router.replace with /home or /login while it shows a spinner.

nodes.name: Claim
nodes.summary: Stateful claim component whose effect picks the flow from the action_token param and tokenAtom: save and ask for auth, redeem now and clear the pending token, or save and ask for a wallet on a no-wallet error, ignoring results after unmount. It renders one screen per status with navigation buttons.

nodes.name: ClaimPage
nodes.summary: Default export of /claim that renders Claim inside Suspense with a plain Loading fallback box, because Claim reads useSearchParams.

nodes.name: LogoutPage
nodes.summary: Component whose mount effect runs the logout sequence (remove the token key, clearStoredTokens, broadcastLogout, await initKeycloak ignoring errors, logout) and shows a spinner.

nodes.name: Page
nodes.summary: Root page component that replaces the route with /home or /login according to useAuth().authenticated and renders LoadingSpinner during the redirect.

nodes.name: getKeycloak
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and returns the single keycloak-js instance from the NEXT_PUBLIC_KEYCLOAK_URL, REALM and CLIENT_ID env vars, and returns null during server rendering.

nodes.name: saveStoredTokens
nodes.summary: Writes the current Keycloak access and refresh token pair to sessionStorage under kc_tokens after each init or refresh, because Keycloak may rotate the refresh token; does nothing when either token is missing.

nodes.name: clearStoredTokens
nodes.summary: Removes the kc_tokens entry from sessionStorage and ignores storage errors; the logout page and KeycloakProvider call it when a session ends.

nodes.name: initKeycloak
nodes.summary: Memoized keycloak-js init with PKCE S256, no login iframe and no onLoad redirect, seeded with tokens from readStoredTokens so a page reload resumes the session; returns false on the server and the same promise on repeated calls.

nodes.name: login
nodes.summary: Starts the Keycloak hosted login redirect with /auth/callback on the current origin as the redirect URI; the /login page calls it.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Starts the Keycloak hosted registration redirect back to /auth/callback; the /signup page calls it.

nodes.name: logout
nodes.summary: Ends the Keycloak SSO session and redirects the browser to /login on the current origin; the /logout page calls it after init.

nodes.name: accountUrl
nodes.summary: Builds the Keycloak account-console URL that returns to the current page, for the Security button on the Account settings page; gives undefined when no instance exists.

nodes.name: broadcastLogout
nodes.summary: Opens the wallet-auth BroadcastChannel, posts a logout message to the other tabs and closes the channel; skips silently when BroadcastChannel is unsupported.

nodes.name: onLogout
nodes.summary: Subscribes a handler to logout messages on the wallet-auth BroadcastChannel and returns an unsubscribe function that removes the listener and closes the channel; the protected layout effect uses it.

nodes.name: ActivityItem
nodes.summary: Exported card component with title, amount, status, showAmount and onClick props; it renders initials from the title, a status caption, and a +/- amount only when amount is defined and showAmount is true, with pointer styling when clickable.

nodes.name: KeycloakProvider.tsx
nodes.summary: React context provider that blocks rendering behind a Keycloak init capped at 8 seconds, mirrors the access token into the shared tokenAtom and sessionStorage, refreshes the token on expiry and when the tab becomes visible, and ends the session only when Keycloak refuses a refresh. It exposes ready and authenticated through the useAuth hook.

nodes.name: LoadingSpinner.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared full-height loading indicator that centers an MUI CircularProgress in an 80vh flex box; auth pages, layouts and Suspense boundaries use it as their fallback.

nodes.name: PendingClaimHandler.tsx
nodes.summary: Background component, mounted by the protected layout only when a pending claim link exists, that redeems the saved action token into the user's first wallet via claimPendingToken once authenticated and shows the outcome in a Snackbar alert.

nodes.name: WalletDetailModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Full-screen send/request overlay for a selected wallet with an on-screen numeric keypad, a note field, Send and Request buttons and a mock destination wallet list; on submit it stores the transaction as pendingTransaction in sessionStorage, calls onTransactionComplete and hard-navigates to /home. The search page opens it.

nodes.name: Header.tsx
nodes.summary: Sticky top app bar for protected pages that switches between the Treetrader logo view, an expanded search view and the notifications header based on HeaderContext state and the current pathname, with theme-driven background colors.

nodes.name: HeaderLogo.tsx
nodes.summary: Small component that renders the Greenstand SVG logo at 50x50 with next/image for the default header view.

nodes.name: HeaderSearch.tsx
nodes.summary: Header search control that shows either a collapsed search icon button (with a 'Coming soon' tooltip when disabled) or an expanded text field bound to the HeaderContext searchQuery, with a back button to collapse.

nodes.name: NotificationHeader.tsx
nodes.summary: Header variant for /notifications with a back arrow that collapses search state and navigates to /home, a Notifications title, and a settings icon button that has no handler yet.

nodes.name: BottomNavigatorBar.tsx
nodes.summary: Fixed bottom navigation bar for protected pages with Home, Wallet, a raised Send image button, Notifications (badged with the incoming transfer count from useIncomingTransfers) and Settings tabs, each routed with next/navigation.

nodes.name: HeaderContext.tsx
nodes.summary: React context that holds the header search UI state (isSearchExpanded, searchQuery, their setters and a toggle); Header, HeaderSearch and the search page read it through the useHeader hook.

nodes.name: actionToken.ts
nodes.summary: localStorage helpers for the pending_action_token key, which keeps an action token captured from a /claim link until PendingClaimHandler or wallet creation can redeem it; every access swallows storage errors.

nodes.name: claimPendingToken.ts
nodes.summary: Redeems a previously saved claim link into a named wallet through redeemActionToken, removing it from storage first so it is never retried, and maps backend errors (expired, not verified, no longer owned) to friendly messages returned as a ClaimOutcome.

nodes.name: userProfile.ts
nodes.summary: Loads the Account screen profile from two sources in order: the user service /me endpoint (email and createdAt) and, when no email comes back, the Keycloak OIDC userinfo endpoint (email only), with sessionExpired decided by Keycloak's 401 first. It also formats the member-since date for display.
nodes.languageNotes: An unset NEXT_PUBLIC_* variable is inlined by next build as the string "undefined", so baseUrl treats that literal as unset to avoid requests to "undefined/me".

nodes.name: useAuth
nodes.summary: Hook that returns the { ready, authenticated } auth state from KeycloakContext; the root page and the auth callback page consume it.

nodes.name: KeycloakProvider
nodes.summary: Provider component whose effect installs onTokenExpired and visibilitychange refresh handlers, runs initKeycloak with an 8000 ms timeout, mirrors or clears tokenAtom and the stored tokens by the result, and renders LoadingSpinner until ready.

nodes.name: LoadingSpinner
nodes.summary: Default-export component that returns a flex Box with minHeight 80vh centering a single CircularProgress.

nodes.name: PendingClaimHandler
nodes.summary: Component that, once tokenAtom and useGetWallets give a token and at least one wallet, calls claimPendingToken with the first wallet's name exactly once (ref guard) and shows the returned severity and message in an auto-hiding Snackbar.

nodes.name: WalletList
nodes.summary: Internal list of mock destination wallets that highlights the clicked row through a local selectedWalletId state; WalletDetailModal shows it after a send action is chosen.

nodes.name: ActionButton
nodes.summary: Internal styled MUI contained Button that merges custom sx and forwards extra props such as data-test; the send, request and submit buttons build on it.

nodes.name: TransactionActionButton
nodes.summary: Internal Send or Request button that is enabled only when its action is selected or default and the amount is non-zero; a click selects the action and moves the modal to the submit step.

nodes.name: Keypad
nodes.summary: Internal 3-column numeric keypad with digits, a decimal point and a clear key (backspace icon) that reports each pressed key to onButtonClick.

nodes.name: WalletDetailModal
nodes.summary: Default-export modal component that keeps amount, selected action, submit step and note in state, builds the amount from keypad input, validates and saves the transaction to sessionStorage on submit, then closes and redirects to /home; returns null when closed.

nodes.name: DefaultHeaderView
nodes.summary: Internal header view that renders HeaderLogo next to the Treetrader title when search is collapsed and the route is not /notifications.

nodes.name: ExpandedSearchView
nodes.summary: Internal header view that renders HeaderSearch in expanded mode and forwards the collapse callback to it.

nodes.name: Header
nodes.summary: Default-export header component that reads isSearchExpanded and its setters from useHeader plus the pathname, picks background and padding from the theme, and renders NotificationHeader, ExpandedSearchView or DefaultHeaderView.

nodes.name: HeaderLogo
nodes.summary: Default-export component that returns a next/image of /assets/images/greenstand-logo.svg with the alt text Tree Trader Logo and object-fit contain.

nodes.name: HeaderSearch
nodes.summary: Default-export component with isExpanded, onExpand, onCollapse and disabled props; when expanded it renders a back button plus a search TextField that writes to setSearchQuery, else a themed search icon button.

nodes.name: NotificationHeader
nodes.summary: Default-export component that takes an onCollapse callback, calls it and pushes /home when the back arrow is clicked, and renders a Notifications title with a settings icon.

nodes.name: BottomNavigationBar
nodes.summary: Default-export component that holds the selected tab index, maps indexes 0-4 to /home, /wallet, /send, /notifications and /settings via router.push, and badges the notifications tab with incoming.length.

nodes.name: HeaderProvider
nodes.summary: Provider component that owns isSearchExpanded and searchQuery state, adds a toggleSearchExpanded helper, and supplies them through HeaderContext; the protected layout mounts it.

nodes.name: useHeader
nodes.summary: Hook that returns the HeaderContext value and throws an error when a component calls it outside a HeaderProvider.

nodes.name: savePendingActionToken
nodes.summary: Stores an action token from a /claim link in localStorage under pending_action_token and ignores unavailable storage; the claim page calls it.

nodes.name: readPendingActionToken
nodes.summary: Returns the saved pending action token from localStorage, or null when the value is missing or storage fails; the protected layout and claimPendingToken read it.

nodes.name: clearPendingActionToken
nodes.summary: Deletes the pending_action_token entry from localStorage and ignores errors; the claim page calls it after a redeem and claimPendingToken calls it before a redeem.

nodes.name: claimPendingToken
nodes.summary: Async function that reads and immediately clears the pending token, redeems it into walletName with the auth token, and returns a success outcome, a mapped error outcome, or null when nothing was pending.

nodes.name: fromUserApi
nodes.summary: Private source that GETs NEXT_PUBLIC_TREETRACKER_USER_API/me with a bearer token and returns email and createdAt, flags a 401 as unauthorized and network or CORS failures as not answered, and is skipped when the URL is unset.

nodes.name: fromKeycloak
nodes.summary: Private source that GETs the Keycloak realm userinfo endpoint and returns the email, falling back to preferred_username when it contains @, with no createdAt; it is skipped when the Keycloak URL or realm is unset.

nodes.name: loadUserProfile
nodes.summary: Exported loader that returns the user service result when it has an email; otherwise it asks Keycloak for the email, keeps the service createdAt, and sets sessionExpired from Keycloak's 401 when Keycloak answered, else from the service's 401.

nodes.name: formatMemberSince
nodes.summary: Formats an ISO date as a US long date such as September 22, 2026, and returns null for missing or unparsable input; the Account page uses it.

nodes.name: _layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Expo Router stack layout for the home tab that shows only the `index` screen and replaces the default header with the shared HeaderSearch bar.
nodes.languageNotes: Expo Router file-based routing: a `_layout.tsx` inside the `(tabs)` route group defines the navigator for its sibling screens, and the group folder name does not appear in the URL.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Home tab screen of the native wallet app. It shows Tokens and Wallets balance cards and a recent-activity FlashList built from mockWalletActivity, swaps to the QR card and SearchResults while the core isSearchingAtom is true, runs a one-time react-native-copilot tour persisted in AsyncStorage, and shows a 6-second snackbar from route params that the transfer entry screen sets.
nodes.languageNotes: react-native-copilot `walkthroughable(View)` plus `CopilotStep` attaches tour steps to existing components. Expo Router search params can be `string | string[]`, so each snackbar param is normalized with `Array.isArray` inside `useMemo`.

nodes.name: _layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Expo Router stack layout for the search tab that renders its index screen with HeaderSearch as the custom header and disables the screen transition animation.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Search tab screen that shows the QR scan card (it routes to /scancode), a 'Top wallets' heading, and the shared SearchResults list that the core search hooks feed.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: First-launch onboarding screen with a horizontal paged FlashList of three illustrated slides (Leaf, Wallet, Cloud SVGs), tappable pagination dots, and SIGN UP / LOG IN buttons that set the AsyncStorage `hasLaunched` flag before they route to the auth register or login screens.

nodes.name: scancode.tsx
nodes.summary: QR scanning screen that requests camera and media-library permissions, reads QR codes live through expo-camera CameraView or from a gallery image through scanFromURLAsync, parses the payload (JSON, URL query, or plain text) into recipient data, and replaces the route with /transfer/entry in SEND mode. A REQ TOKENS button opens /transfer in REQUEST mode.
nodes.languageNotes: Every handler is wrapped in `useCallback` with explicit dependencies, and an `isScanLocked` state flag unsets `onBarcodeScanned` so CameraView does not fire twice for one code.

nodes.name: entry.tsx
nodes.summary: Transfer amount entry screen that reads recipient id, name, avatar, and mode from route params, shows the recipient Avatar with an amount input and a note field, and on SEND or REQUEST replaces the route with /home plus snackbar params. It does not call any transfer API yet.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Transfer recipient picker screen that sets the core search category atom to SEND or REQUEST from the `mode` param, shows HeaderSearch with a back arrow to /home, the QR scan card, and SearchResults whose item press pushes /transfer/entry with the chosen recipient.

nodes.name: notification.tsx
nodes.summary: Pending-transfer confirmation screen that builds a 'Pending request/tokens to <name>' notice from the recipientName, amount, and mode route params, shows it in a cream notification card with initials, and offers a 'Go to home' button.

nodes.name: HeaderSearch.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared app header that the home, search, wallet, and transfer screens use. It toggles between a green logo bar (search icon, placeholder filter icon, or an optional back arrow) and a white search box that writes to the core Jotai search atoms and shows a spinner while searchLoadingAtom is true.
nodes.languageNotes: Value atoms are read with `useAtom` and action atoms are taken with `useSetAtom`, which does not subscribe to value changes. A second `<StatusBar hidden />` at the end of the tree hides the status bar and overrides the styled StatusBar above it.

nodes.name: Cloud.tsx
nodes.summary: react-native-svg illustration of a green cloud with 101x101 defaults, shown as the third onboarding slide icon; it spreads SvgProps so callers can resize it.

nodes.name: Leaf.tsx
nodes.summary: react-native-svg illustration of two green leaves that grow from a ground ellipse, default-exported as the `Leaft` component and shown on the first onboarding slide.
nodes.languageNotes: The component identifier is misspelled `Leaft`. The onboarding screen imports the default export under the name `Leafs`, so the typo does not leak to callers.

nodes.name: wallet.tsx
nodes.summary: react-native-svg illustration of an open green wallet with card flaps, shown as the second onboarding slide icon; it forwards SvgProps for sizing.

nodes.name: HomeLayout
nodes.summary: Returns an expo-router Stack whose only screen, `index`, shows HeaderSearch as its header while the stack default hides headers.

nodes.name: Home
nodes.summary: Default-exported home screen component. It reads the search atoms, resets the category to 'all' when search closes, starts the copilot tour after 300 ms when AsyncStorage has no hasSeenHomeTour flag, and builds the snackbar text ('N Tokens sent!' or 'requested!') from route params.

nodes.name: BalanceCard
nodes.summary: Wraps a WalletSummary tile for one balanceData entry with a toll or wallet icon and, for the Tokens and Wallets labels, places it inside a numbered CopilotStep so the home tour can highlight it.

nodes.name: SearchLayout
nodes.summary: Returns an expo-router Stack for the search tab whose index screen uses HeaderSearch as its header with `animation: "none"`.

nodes.name: Search
nodes.summary: Renders the search tab body: QRCodeDisplay with a handler that pushes /scancode, a medium-weight 'Top wallets' Heading, and SearchResults without an item press handler.

nodes.name: OnboardingScreen
nodes.summary: Tracks the current slide from the FlashList momentum scroll offset, scrolls to a slide when a dot is pressed, and stores `hasLaunched=true` in AsyncStorage before it pushes /(auth)/register or /(auth)/login.

nodes.name: getStringValue
nodes.summary: Returns the first trimmed, non-empty string value that a record holds under any of the given candidate keys, or undefined; parseQrPayload uses it to read alias keys.

nodes.name: parseQrPayload
nodes.summary: Converts a raw QR string into recipientId, recipientName, and recipientAvatar. It tries a JSON object with alias keys, then URL query parameters, then falls back to the raw text cut to 80 characters, and returns null for empty input.

nodes.name: ScanCodeScreen
nodes.summary: Default-exported scanner component that wires camera permission checks, a scan lock against duplicate reads, gallery image decoding with error alerts, and navigation to /transfer/entry for a decoded payload or back to /transfer.

nodes.name: TransferEntryScreen
nodes.summary: Normalizes the recipient and mode route params, keeps amount and note state, disables the action unless the amount parses to a positive number, and on press replaces the route with /home plus snackbarAction, snackbarAmount, and a timestamp snackbarKey.

nodes.name: TransferRecipientScreen
nodes.summary: Derives SEND or REQUEST mode from the route param, syncs it to selectCategoryAtom in an effect, and pushes /transfer/entry with the pressed search item's id, name, and string avatar.

nodes.name: TransferNotificationScreen
nodes.summary: Builds mode-specific pending title and description strings from route params and renders them beside a two-letter initials badge, with back, close, and 'Go to home' controls that replace the route with /home.

nodes.name: HeaderSearch
nodes.summary: Header component with optional showBackOnLeft and onLeftBackPress props. It sets the header height to 25% of the window width, runs performSearch on every text change, and starts or cancels search mode through Jotai action atoms.

nodes.name: Cloud
nodes.summary: Arrow-function SVG component that draws the cloud illustration from filled and stroked Path elements and spreads incoming SvgProps over the 101x101 defaults.

nodes.name: Leaft
nodes.summary: Arrow-function SVG component that draws two leaves, a stem, and a ground shadow, with incoming SvgProps overriding the 101x101 size.

nodes.name: Wallet
nodes.summary: Arrow-function SVG component that draws the wallet body, card flaps, and clasp from ten Path elements and accepts SvgProps overrides.

nodes.name: QRCodeDisplay.tsx
nodes.summary: Pressable 'Scan or show QR code' card with a QR icon Avatar and a 'Quickly send or request tokens' subtitle. The home, search, and transfer recipient screens render it and pass an onPress that routes to /scancode.

nodes.name: SearchResultItem.tsx
nodes.summary: Single pressable row in the search results list that shows a wallet Avatar and name and passes the whole item to the optional onPress callback.

nodes.name: SearchResults.tsx
nodes.summary: Search results list that reads `sections` and `hasNoResults` from the core useSearchResults hook and renders a tuned SectionList of SearchResultItem rows, or EmptyState when nothing matches; it forwards onItemPress to each row.

nodes.name: WalletItem.tsx
nodes.summary: Recent-activity row for the home screen FlashList that shows the Greenstand logo, a wallet name, its Sent/Received status, and a balance, styled from module-level THEME values.

nodes.name: WalletSummary.tsx
nodes.summary: Balance summary card that shows an icon, a label, and a large right-aligned value, sized from the screen WIDTH; the home BalanceCard uses it for the Tokens and Wallets tiles. It declares a `style` prop but does not apply it, so the width that BalanceCard passes has no effect.

nodes.name: Avatar.tsx
nodes.summary: Circular avatar component that shows uppercase initials from getInitials on a gray background when no avatarUrl is given. Otherwise it loads the URL with expo-image and switches to a fallback image (by default the Greenstand logo) on a load error.

nodes.name: CustomButton.tsx
nodes.summary: Full-width TouchableOpacity button with a green primary variant and a transparent, gray-text secondary variant that merges caller style and textStyle overrides; the onboarding and transfer screens use it.

nodes.name: EmptyState.tsx
nodes.summary: Centered empty-results placeholder with an emoji icon, a message, and an optional sub-message, defaulting to 'No results found'; SearchResults renders it when the search returns nothing.

nodes.name: Heading.tsx
nodes.summary: Bold 20px Text heading that takes a title and merges any TextProps style; the home, search, transfer, and login screens use it for section titles.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: Hard-coded mock list of eight wallet activity records (id, name, Sent/Received status, balance) that the home screen renders as its recent-activity list.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Design-token module for the native app. It exports LAYOUT (screen-relative paddings and spacing), COLORS (Greenstand greens and a gray scale), TYPOGRAPHY (Roboto sizes and font names), SPACING, a width-based scaleSize helper, the combined THEME object, and keyof-derived types such as TypographyWeight.
nodes.languageNotes: Each token object uses `as const`, and the exported types (`ColorPalette`, `TypographyWeight`, ...) derive from them with `keyof typeof`. TYPOGRAPHY.weight holds font-family names such as `Roboto_500Medium`, yet many screens cast them to TypographyWeight and pass them as `fontWeight`.

nodes.name: dimensions.ts
nodes.summary: Exports the device screen size (WIDTH, HEIGHT) and window size (WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT), read once at module load from React Native Dimensions; the theme, HeaderSearch, and WalletSummary use them.

nodes.name: getInitials.ts
nodes.summary: Default-exported helper module that turns a name into up to two uppercase initials; Avatar uses it for its no-image fallback.

nodes.name: QRCodeDisplay
nodes.summary: Resolves the bundled QRIcon.png asset URI, renders it through Avatar inside an accessible Pressable card that dims to 0.85 opacity while pressed, and calls the optional onPress prop.

nodes.name: SearchResultItem
nodes.summary: Renders one search hit as a white Pressable row with a 40px Avatar and the item name, and invokes onPress(item) when the prop is provided.

nodes.name: SearchResults
nodes.summary: Calls useSearchResults, returns EmptyState when hasNoResults is true, and otherwise renders a SectionList with batching and clipped-subview settings for scroll performance.

nodes.name: WalletItem
nodes.summary: Renders one activity row with the static Greenstand logo image, the item name, muted status text, and the balance number on the right.

nodes.name: WalletSummary
nodes.summary: Renders the card layout from the icon, label, and value props and drops the declared style prop without using it.

nodes.name: Avatar
nodes.summary: Shows initials when avatarUrl is null and no fallback is active; otherwise renders an expo-image Image keyed by id whose onError handler logs a warning and switches to fallbackImage.

nodes.name: CustomButton
nodes.summary: React.FC that flattens the base, secondary-variant, and caller styles for a TouchableOpacity and its Text label, then calls onPress on tap.

nodes.name: EmptyState
nodes.summary: Function component that renders the icon, the message at typography lg size, and the sub-message at sm size only when the sub-message is non-empty.

nodes.name: Heading
nodes.summary: Spreads the remaining TextProps onto a Text element and combines the default bold title style with the caller style prop.

nodes.name: scaleSize
nodes.summary: Scales a pixel size by the window width relative to a 375 px base, caps the scale factor at 1.5, and rounds the result; THEME exposes it as theme.scaleSize.

nodes.name: getInitials
nodes.summary: Splits the value on spaces, drops empty parts, uppercases the first letter of each word, and joins at most the first two letters.

nodes.name: swagger.ts
nodes.summary: Exports setupSwagger, which builds an OpenAPI document titled "API" (version 2.0.0, bearer auth) and mounts Swagger UI at /swagger on the NestJS app; main.ts calls it only outside production.

nodes.name: login-user.dto.ts
nodes.summary: Defines LoginUserDto, the POST /login request body with required non-empty string username and password, validated by class-validator and documented with @ApiProperty; UserController and UserService consume it.

nodes.name: register-user.dto.ts
nodes.summary: Defines RegisterUserDto, the POST /register request body with optional firstName and lastName, a required username, a valid email, and a password of at least 8 characters; UserController.registerUser and UserService.createUser consume it.

nodes.name: app.module.ts
nodes.summary: Root NestJS module of the user API: it runs dotenv, selects .dev.env or .env for ConfigModule from NODE_ENV, and wires UserModule, HttpModule, QueueModule, and AuthModule with UserController, UserService, and AuthService. main.ts bootstraps it and the e2e suite compiles it.
nodes.languageNotes: UserController and UserService are registered both here and inside UserModule, so AppModule creates a second set of these providers.

nodes.name: auth.module.ts
nodes.summary: NestJS module that imports HttpModule and provides and exports AuthService, so AppModule, UserModule, and QueueModule can inject the Keycloak service-account token client.

nodes.name: auth.service.ts
nodes.summary: Injectable AuthService that gets a Keycloak service-account access token with the client_credentials grant and caches it in memory until expires_in elapses. UserService and QueueListenerService call getToken() to authorize Keycloak admin and Wallet API requests.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses rxjs firstValueFrom to turn the Observable from @nestjs/axios HttpService into a Promise.

nodes.name: auth.spec.int.ts
nodes.summary: Jest integration tests for AuthService with a mocked HttpService.post that cover the first token fetch, cache reuse, refresh after expiry, the expiresAt arithmetic, and HttpException on network errors and Keycloak 401 responses.

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Entry point of the NestJS user API: bootstrap creates the app from AppModule, enables Swagger outside production, applies a whitelisting ValidationPipe and environment-driven CORS, and listens on PORT (default 8080) on 0.0.0.0, exiting with code 1 when startup fails.

nodes.name: onQueueNotification.ts
nodes.summary: Helper that subscribes the user API client to the PostgreSQL "wallets/creation" channel through the shared queue package and passes the account_id from each message to a callback; QueueListenerService uses it to react to new wallets.
nodes.languageNotes: Most of the file is a commented-out earlier LISTEN implementation; the module-level messageObj with a random capture_id is only used for its channel name.

nodes.name: queue-listener.module.ts
nodes.summary: NestJS module named QueueModule that imports HttpModule and AuthModule and provides and exports QueueListenerService, so the wallet-creation listener starts when AppModule loads.

nodes.name: queue-listener.service.ts
nodes.summary: Injectable QueueListenerService that registers a wallet-creation queue callback at module init; for each account_id it lists the account's managed wallets from the Wallet API (/wallet/v2/wallets) and transfers a reward token bundle from SENDER_WALLET_ID to the first wallet.
nodes.languageNotes: transferToken interpolates this.authService.getToken() without await, so the Authorization header holds a stringified Promise; the integration test mocks getToken synchronously and does not catch this.

nodes.name: queue-listener.spec.int.ts
nodes.summary: Jest integration test for QueueListenerService that mocks onQueueNotification to capture the callback, then checks that one queued account_id causes a GET to /wallet/v2/wallets and a POST to /wallet/v2/transfers with the reward bundle and bearer headers.

nodes.name: user.controller.spec.int.ts
nodes.summary: Supertest integration suite that boots UserModule with a mocked UserService and a real ValidationPipe, and checks the HTTP status mapping of POST /register (201, 409, 403, optional names) and POST /login (200, 400 on empty or missing body, 401, 500).

nodes.name: user.controller.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Jest unit tests for UserController with a stubbed UserService that assert registerUser forwards the RegisterUserDto to createUser and loginUser forwards the credentials to UserService.loginUser and returns its access_token.

nodes.name: user.controller.ts
nodes.summary: NestJS UserController that exposes POST /login (HTTP 200), POST /register, GET /healthz (returns "tree growing!!"), and GET /me, which strips the Bearer prefix and rejects a missing token with 401; all business work goes to UserService.
nodes.languageNotes: The healthz handler declares an unused @Body() RegisterUserDto parameter.

nodes.name: user.module.ts
nodes.summary: Feature module that imports HttpModule and AuthModule and registers UserController and UserService, so the user endpoints get the Keycloak HTTP client and the service-account token provider.

nodes.name: user.service.ts
nodes.summary: Injectable UserService that proxies user operations to Keycloak: password-grant login, admin-API user creation with the service-account token, and a profile lookup that combines userinfo with the admin user record. It maps Keycloak errors to NestJS HttpExceptions for UserController.

nodes.name: api.spec.e2e.ts
nodes.summary: End-to-end Jest suite that boots the full AppModule against a live Keycloak and calls POST /register and POST /login with timestamped users, expecting 201 with a success message and a login access_token longer than 100 characters.
nodes.languageNotes: The case named "should return 409 when a user exists with same username" registers a new unique user and expects 201, so the conflict path is not tested here.

nodes.name: index.spec.js
nodes.summary: Jest test for the queue package that subscribes two pg clients to a "tree" channel, publishes one message, and asserts that each emitter receives the matching row with an ack timestamp for its client ID; it needs a live DATABASE_URL.

nodes.name: ack.js
nodes.summary: Exports ack, which records a client's receipt of a queue.message row by writing a timestamp into ack[clientID] with jsonb_set, then re-reads and verifies the row; subscribe.js calls it for each notification.
nodes.languageNotes: The SQL is built by string interpolation of clientID, dateStr, and id (an injection risk), and errors thrown inside the pg callbacks do not reject the returned Promise.

nodes.name: index.js
nodes.summary: Barrel entry of the queue package that re-exports subscribe and publish as a CommonJS object for consumers of the PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY message queue.

nodes.name: pgClient.js
nodes.summary: Creates and connects two pg Client instances (pgClient and pgClient2) from DATABASE_URL loaded by dotenv and logs the connection status with loglevel; the user API notification helper and the queue tests import them.
nodes.languageNotes: The module connects at import time and prints the full DATABASE_URL to the console, which can expose credentials in logs.

nodes.name: publish.js
nodes.summary: Exports publish, which inserts a channel and data payload into the queue.message table with a parameterized INSERT ... RETURNING query; subscribe.js listeners then expect a notification that carries the new row id.

nodes.name: subscribe.js
nodes.summary: Exports async subscribe, which issues LISTEN on a channel for a pg client, acknowledges each notified row through ack, and returns an EventEmitter that emits "message" with the acknowledged queue.message row.

nodes.name: setupSwagger
nodes.summary: Builds a DocumentBuilder config (title API, version 2.0.0, bearer auth), generates the OpenAPI document with SwaggerModule.createDocument, and serves it at the /swagger path.

nodes.name: LoginUserDto
nodes.summary: Class-validator DTO that holds username and password, both marked @IsString and @IsNotEmpty with @ApiProperty, so the global ValidationPipe returns 400 for empty login bodies.

nodes.name: RegisterUserDto
nodes.summary: Registration DTO whose decorators make firstName and lastName optional strings, require username, enforce @IsEmail on email, and require @MinLength(8) on password.

nodes.name: AppModule
nodes.summary: Decorated root module class that composes the user, queue, auth, HTTP, and environment-config modules and registers UserController with UserService and AuthService providers.

nodes.name: AuthModule
nodes.summary: Empty module class whose @Module metadata provides and exports AuthService together with HttpModule, which makes the service-account token client injectable in other modules.

nodes.name: AuthService
nodes.summary: Keeps a Keycloak client_credentials bearer token and its expiry timestamp in private fields; getToken returns the cached token, or refreshes it when the token is missing or expired.

nodes.name: fetchTokenFromKeycloak
nodes.summary: Posts client_id, client_secret, and grant_type=client_credentials to the realm openid-connect token endpoint, stores access_token and the expiry (now + expires_in seconds), and on failure logs and throws an HttpException with the upstream status or 503.

nodes.name: bootstrap
nodes.summary: Async startup routine that creates the Nest app with error/warn/log logging, mounts Swagger in non-production, builds CORS origins from CORS_ORIGINS or CORS_ORIGINS_DEV (localhost defaults), sets a global ValidationPipe, and starts listening.

nodes.name: onQueueNotification
nodes.summary: Calls the shared subscribe with pgClient, the "wallets/creation" channel, and client ID "user-api-client", then attaches a "message" listener that JSON-parses msg.payload and passes account_id to the callback.
nodes.languageNotes: subscribe.js emits the acknowledged queue.message row (channel, data, ack), not a raw pg notification, so reading msg.payload here appears inconsistent with the emitted shape.

nodes.name: QueueModule
nodes.summary: Module class whose metadata imports HttpModule and AuthModule and provides and exports QueueListenerService for the root AppModule.

nodes.name: QueueListenerService
nodes.summary: Implements OnModuleInit to hook onQueueNotification at startup, and uses injected HttpService and AuthService to call the Wallet API wallets and transfers endpoints for newly created accounts.

nodes.name: transferToken
nodes.summary: POSTs to /wallet/v2/transfers a bundle of REGISTER_REWARD_TOKEN_COUNT tokens from SENDER_WALLET_ID to the given wallet, logs the outcome, and returns { transferStatus: true } on both success and failure.
nodes.languageNotes: The Authorization header interpolates an un-awaited getToken() Promise, and the catch branch also reports transferStatus true.

nodes.name: sendToWalletApi
nodes.summary: Gets a service-account token, GETs /wallet/v2/wallets?account_id=<id> to list the account's managed wallets, and calls transferToken for the first wallet or logs an error when the account has none.

nodes.name: UserController
nodes.summary: Controller class with a constructor-injected UserService whose handlers map the /login, /register, /healthz, and /me routes; getMe extracts the token from the Authorization header before it delegates.

nodes.name: UserModule
nodes.summary: Module class that registers UserController and UserService with HttpModule and AuthModule imports; the controller integration spec compiles it with an overridden UserService.

nodes.name: UserService
nodes.summary: Holds HttpService and AuthService and implements loginUser, createUser, and getMe against Keycloak realm endpoints that the PRIVATE_KEYCLOAK_* environment variables configure.

nodes.name: loginUser
nodes.summary: Checks that username and password exist, posts a password-grant form (with an optional client secret) to the Keycloak token endpoint, and returns { access_token }; it rethrows HttpExceptions and maps other errors to the upstream status and message.

nodes.name: createUser
nodes.summary: Gets the service-account token, posts a new enabled user with a non-temporary password credential to the Keycloak admin users API, returns a success message on HTTP 201, and maps 409 to CONFLICT and other failures to 403.

nodes.name: getMe
nodes.summary: Validates the caller's token through Keycloak userinfo, reads the user's admin record with the service-account token, and returns the email and createdAt as an ISO string; an upstream 401 becomes "Invalid or expired token".

nodes.name: ack
nodes.summary: Runs a jsonb_set UPDATE that stamps ack[clientID] with dateStr on the queue.message row, then SELECTs the row, throws when the stored timestamp differs, and resolves with res.rows.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.summary: Runs a parameterized INSERT of channel and data into queue.message RETURNING *, logs a dispatch message on success, and throws an insertion error from the callback on failure.

nodes.name: subscribe
nodes.summary: Creates an EventEmitter, issues LISTEN "<channel>" on the pg client, and on every notification parses the row id, calls ack with an ISO timestamp, and emits "message" with the first returned row.

nodes.name: checkEmail.tsx
nodes.summary: Expo Router screen at /(auth)/checkEmail shown after a password-reset request; it offers a back-arrow Link to /login, a BACK TO LOGIN CustomSubmitButton that pushes /(auth)/login, and an empty /forgotPassword resend Link whose ThemedText copy is commented out.

nodes.name: forgotPassword.tsx
nodes.summary: Expo Router auth screen where the user types an email into a CustomTextInput that is regex-validated on every keystroke, then taps SEND THE LINK to navigate to /(auth)/checkEmail; no password-reset API call exists yet.
nodes.languageNotes: The CustomSubmitButton style prop wraps a ternary and an array in parentheses joined by a comma operator, so the ternary result is discarded and only the uppercase style array reaches the button.

nodes.name: login.tsx
nodes.summary: Expo Router login screen with email and password CustomTextInput fields, a Heading title, a LOG IN CustomSubmitButton, Gmail/Facebook/GitHub SocialLoginButton stubs, and a Sign up link to /register; a successful press routes to /(tabs)/home and writes isAuth to AsyncStorage.
nodes.languageNotes: handleLogIn reads isAuth immediately after setAuth(true); React state updates are asynchronous, so the first press only flips the flag and a second press is needed to navigate.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Settings tab screen that renders a static list of seven entries (Account, Notifications, Data & Privacy, Legal, Support, About, Send feedback with an app version subtitle) and a LOG OUT button; item and logout handlers only log to the console for now.

nodes.name: [walletId].tsx
nodes.summary: Dynamic Expo Router wallet detail screen that reads walletId, name, and balance search params, sets the native header title and a filter button, and switches between an Activity tab (WalletActivity fed by placeholder data) and a Details tab (WalletDetails), with a WalletFilterModal overlay.
nodes.languageNotes: WALLET_TABS is declared 'as const' so the WalletTab union type is derived from the array values with an indexed access type.

nodes.name: _layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Expo Router Stack layout for the wallet tab: the index route uses the custom HeaderSearch component as its header, and the [walletId] route gets a minimal-back-button native header with Colors.darkGray text on a white background.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Wallets tab home screen that lists two hard-coded mock wallets with WalletList, opens WalletCreateDrawer from the CreateWallet row, coordinates the discard-changes prompt, and pushes /(tabs)/wallet/[walletId] with name, balance, and date params when a wallet is tapped.

nodes.name: CustomModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable bottom-sheet modal built on the React Native Modal with a slide animation, a tap-to-dismiss translucent overlay, and a white rounded sheet sized to half the window height; WalletCreateDrawer, WalletFilterModal, and ActionSelectionModal render their content inside it.

nodes.name: CustomSubmitButton.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared full-width Pressable submit button with a green background and uppercase white label, used by the login, forgot-password, and check-email screens and by WalletCreateDrawer; its disabled prop is inverted, so true makes the button active.
nodes.languageNotes: The disabled prop has inverted semantics: onPress is attached only when disabled is true and Pressable receives disabled={!disabled}, so callers pass their 'is enabled' flag as disabled.

nodes.name: CustomTextInput.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared Material-style text field with an animated floating label, green focus and red error underlines, an error icon with helper text, a password visibility toggle, a clear-text button, and multiline support; the login, forgot-password, and WalletCreateDrawer forms use it.
nodes.languageNotes: The floating label uses an Animated.Value interpolated into both top offset and fontSize with useNativeDriver: false, because layout properties cannot run on the native driver.

nodes.name: SocialLoginButton.tsx
nodes.summary: Outlined social sign-in button that maps a provider prop (Gmail, Facebook, or GitHub) to a green MaterialCommunityIcons or FontAwesome icon and shows a 'Log in with <provider>' label; the login screen renders three of them.

nodes.name: CreateWalletButton.tsx
nodes.summary: Bordered row on the Wallets screen with a CREATE WALLET touch target and add icon that turns green while the create drawer is open, plus an info circle whose press handler only logs a placeholder message.

nodes.name: DiscardChangesModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Centered fade-in confirmation dialog that asks 'Discard changes?' about an unsaved new wallet, with KEEP CHANGES and a red-outlined DISCARD action; WalletCreateDrawer shows it when the user closes a form that has input.

nodes.name: WalletActivity.tsx
nodes.summary: Exports the WalletTransaction type and the wallet Activity tab view, which renders Pending and Completed sections of transaction rows with initials avatars, dates, and signed amounts, or an empty-state card when a list has no items.

nodes.name: WalletCreateDrawer.tsx
nodes.summary: Bottom-sheet wallet creation form inside CustomModal that collects a name and multiline description, rejects empty or case-insensitive duplicate names, lifts itself above the keyboard with LayoutAnimation, reports dirty state on close, and can overlay DiscardChangesModal.
nodes.languageNotes: Keyboard listeners use keyboardWillShow/Hide on iOS and keyboardDidShow/Hide on Android, and the effect cleanup removes both subscriptions.

nodes.name: WalletDetails.tsx
nodes.summary: Details tab content for a wallet that shows the balance with en-US digit grouping beside a toll icon and unit label, plus a card with Edit wallet and Delete wallet action rows; it mixes the Colors constants with the COLORS token from the theme module.

nodes.name: WalletFilterModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Bottom-sheet filter panel for wallet activity with radio options (All, Past 90 days, May, 2024), From/To date-range fields backed by @react-native-community/datetimepicker, and an APPLY button that passes the choice and ISO date strings to onApply.
nodes.languageNotes: Date picking branches on Platform.OS: Android renders the default picker dialog and commits on change, while iOS shows a spinner in a nested Modal and holds the value in tempDate until Done.

nodes.name: WalletList.tsx
nodes.summary: Presentational 'Your wallets' card that renders each wallet's name, date, and green balance with a chevron as a touchable row between dividers, reports the tapped wallet id through onWalletPress, and shows 'No wallets found' for an empty array.

nodes.name: Colors.ts
nodes.summary: Central color palette for the native app with light and dark theme sets (text, background, tint, icon, tab icon colors) and flat brand values such as green #61892F, red, charcoal, grays, and overlay and shadow rgba strings; most screens and components import it, as do useThemeColor and Collapsible.

nodes.name: walletActivityPlaceholder.ts
nodes.summary: Temporary mock wallet activity keyed by wallet id ('default', '1', '2'), each with pending and completed WalletTransaction lists and a 'May 2024' label, plus a lookup getter; its doc comment says to delete the file once the real API is wired up.

nodes.name: CheckEmailScreen
nodes.summary: Renders the check-email view in a KeyboardAvoidingView with a Feather back-arrow Link to /login and a BACK TO LOGIN button whose handler calls router.push('/(auth)/login'); it passes disabled={true}, which keeps the button active.

nodes.name: ForgotPasswordScreen
nodes.summary: Holds email and validity state, re-checks the address against an email regex on each keystroke to toggle the CustomTextInput error and helper text, and on SEND THE LINK pushes /(auth)/checkEmail.

nodes.name: LoginScreen
nodes.summary: Manages email, password, and isAuth state, enables LOG IN only when both fields have text, and on press sets isAuth and, once it is already true, navigates to /(tabs)/home and saves isAuth in AsyncStorage; social buttons only log the provider.

nodes.name: SettingsItem
nodes.summary: Pressable settings row that shows a MaterialIcons glyph in a round container, the title with an optional subtitle, and a chevron, with a pressed background, Android ripple, and an accessibility label that joins title and subtitle.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Default-exported settings screen that maps settingsItems to SettingsItem rows with separators under a 'Settings' heading and adds a LOG OUT pressable; handleItemPress and handleLogout are console.log placeholders.

nodes.name: WalletDetail
nodes.summary: Parses route params with mapParamsToString, derives the header title and a finite balance, loads activity via getPlaceholderWalletActivity, sets header options in useLayoutEffect with a filter button only on the Activity tab, and renders the TabButton bar, the active tab, and WalletFilterModal.

nodes.name: HeaderFilterButton
nodes.summary: Header-right Pressable with an 'Open filters' accessibility label that draws a filter glyph from three gray bars of decreasing width; WalletDetail mounts it to open the filter modal.

nodes.name: TabButton
nodes.summary: Tab-role Pressable for the Activity/Details bar that exposes its selected state to accessibility, colors its uppercase label green when active, and draws a green underline indicator.

nodes.name: WalletLayout
nodes.summary: Returns an expo-router Stack that hides headers by default, uses HeaderSearch as the header of the index screen, and gives the [walletId] screen a white header with darkGray tint and a bold 18pt title.

nodes.name: Wallet
nodes.summary: Wallets screen component that tracks drawer and discard-prompt visibility, closes the drawer directly or through the discard prompt depending on isDirty, logs submitted wallet data, and routes to the detail page with the selected mock wallet's params.

nodes.name: CustomModal
nodes.summary: Wraps children in a transparent slide-up Modal where a Pressable overlay calls onClose and the content sits in an absolutely positioned bottom sheet that callers can restyle through containerStyle.

nodes.name: CustomSubmitButton
nodes.summary: Renders a Pressable with an uppercase title that wires onPress and the green style only when the disabled prop is true, and otherwise shows a grey inactive look; the caller-supplied style is appended last.

nodes.name: CustomTextInput
nodes.summary: Controlled TextInput component that animates its label between resting and floating positions on focus and blur, shows the placeholder only when focused or multiline, and swaps the trailing icon among an error alert, an eye toggle for secure entry, and a clear button.

nodes.name: SocialLoginButton
nodes.summary: Looks up the provider icon in an inline iconMap (Gmail envelope, Facebook logo in a green circle, GitHub mark) and renders it with the 'Log in with' label inside a TouchableOpacity that calls onPress.

nodes.name: CreateWallet
nodes.summary: Renders the create-wallet row: an add icon and CREATE WALLET text that call onPress and turn green when isActive, and a grey 'i' circle whose handleInfoPress only writes to the console.

nodes.name: DiscardChangesModal
nodes.summary: Shows a transparent fade Modal with a card titled 'Discard changes?'; the overlay, the close icon, and KEEP CHANGES call onKeep, while the DISCARD button calls onDiscard.

nodes.name: WalletActivity
nodes.summary: Exported activity view that stacks a Pending and a Completed ActivitySection and passes each its transaction array, optional subtitle, and empty-state message; the wallet detail screen feeds it placeholder data.

nodes.name: ActivitySection
nodes.summary: Renders a titled section with an optional uppercase subtitle and either an empty-state card or a bordered card of TransactionItem rows separated by hairline dividers.

nodes.name: TransactionItem
nodes.summary: Displays one transaction row with an initials avatar from getInitials, the title and date, and an amount prefixed with + or - and grouped with en-US separators, colored green when non-negative.

nodes.name: WalletCreateDrawer
nodes.summary: Keeps name and description state, computes duplicate-name and dirty flags with useMemo, clears fields when hidden, moves the sheet up on keyboard show and hide events, submits trimmed values only for a valid name, and mounts DiscardChangesModal when showDiscardPrompt is set.

nodes.name: WalletDetails
nodes.summary: Exported details view that renders the balance card (en-US formatted number, toll icon in COLORS.gray400, unit label defaulting to Tokens) and two ActionButton rows wired to the optional onEdit and onDelete callbacks.

nodes.name: ActionButton
nodes.summary: Accessible Pressable row for wallet actions that lays out a supplied icon, a label, and a chevron-forward icon, dims to 0.6 opacity while pressed, and widens the touch area with hitSlop.

nodes.name: WalletFilterModal
nodes.summary: Holds the selected filter (default 'may'), from/to dates, and picker state; openPicker seeds the picker from existing dates, handleDateChange commits at once on Android or stashes tempDate on iOS until handleConfirm, and handleApply sends the filter and ISO dates to onApply before closing.

nodes.name: RadioButton
nodes.summary: Radio-role Pressable that draws an outer ring that turns green when checked, with a green inner dot, beside its label; WalletFilterModal renders one per FILTER_OPTIONS entry.

nodes.name: DateRangeInput
nodes.summary: Labeled pseudo-input for the From and To fields that shows the formatted date or a placeholder next to a calendar icon and calls onPress to open the date picker.

nodes.name: WalletList
nodes.summary: Maps the wallets array to touchable rows keyed by React.Fragment, calls the optional onWalletPress with the wallet id, and renders the 'Your wallets' title or an empty-state card when there are no wallets.

nodes.name: getPlaceholderWalletActivity
nodes.summary: Returns the PLACEHOLDER_WALLET_ACTIVITY entry for a wallet id, or the default entry when the id is unknown; WalletDetail calls it to fill the Activity tab.

nodes.name: RecentActivity.cy.tsx
nodes.summary: Cypress component test that mounts RecentActivity with one 'Restaurant XY' entry and checks that the 'Recent Activity' heading and the entry title render, and that the 'View all' link has href /transfers.

nodes.name: TokenBalance.cy.tsx
nodes.summary: Cypress component test that mounts TokenBalance with tokenCount 1000 and asserts that the 'Tokens' label and the value 1000 appear on the rendered card.

nodes.name: WalletBalance.cy.tsx
nodes.summary: Cypress component test that mounts WalletBalance with walletAmount 500 and asserts that the 'Wallet' label and the value 500 appear on the rendered card.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js client page for the protected /home route: it loads the user's wallets and the 5 latest transfers through @treetracker/wallet hooks, shows token-total and wallet-count balance cards plus a recent-activity list, and opens a success snackbar for a transaction that a send or request flow stored in sessionStorage under 'pendingTransaction'.
nodes.languageNotes: The '(protected)' folder is a Next.js App Router route group: the parentheses keep it out of the URL, so this file serves /home. The 'use client' directive is necessary because the page uses hooks and sessionStorage.

nodes.name: ActivityList.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component that maps an ActivityEntry[] array to a vertical stack of ActivityItem rows inside an MUI Box; RecentActivity renders it when activity data is present.

nodes.name: RecentActivity.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component for the home page 'Recent Activity' section: it shows a heading with a green 'View all' NextLink to /transfers, then three skeleton rows while loading, an empty-state message when there are no entries, or an ActivityList otherwise.

nodes.name: TokenBalance.tsx
nodes.summary: Thin client component that renders a CustomBalanceCard with a green TollOutlined icon for the user's total token count, and appends '(N pending)' to the 'Tokens' label when pendingCount is positive.

nodes.name: TransactionSnackbar.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component that wraps an MUI Snackbar and a dark success Alert which auto-hides after 6 seconds, shows '<amount> Tokens sent!' or '<amount> Tokens requested!', and offers an UNDO button; the home page drives it from SnackbarContext state.

nodes.name: WalletBalance.tsx
nodes.summary: Thin client component that renders a CustomBalanceCard labeled 'Wallet' with an outlined wallet icon, so the home page can show how many wallets the user owns and a spinner while the wallets load.

nodes.name: activity.types.ts
